en: The postcard is a vintage black-and-white printed card with two images. The left image shows a forested landscape, viewed from a house balcony, possibly with a creek running alongside. The right image shows a large German-style manor or guesthouse ('Waldhaus'), a traditional timber-framed building surrounded by trees and a quiet road. The card has German text in red and black.
